summary: End-to-end frontend verification of the /thesis dashboard redesign (Fase A + B). All 21 functional checkpoints passed. Auth via session_token cookie worked; sidebar 'Mis tesis y empresas (3)' rendered at the top right aligned with the page hero. The megatendencias bar, generator, 'Tesis automática' button (next to the trend/company tabs) and ThesisExplore treemap were all present and functional. Sidebar search ('NVDA') returned 1 live option. CompanyTrendsDropdown for NVDA opened and showed 2 trend options, both styled green (NVDA is included in both seeded trend theses — correct). Trend rows expose `sidebar-trend-folder-<id>` selects with the 2 expected options ('— Megatendencia —' + 'IA & Cómputo'). Megatendencia create+delete round-trip worked (chip count 1→2→1). The ThesisExplore 4 views (megatrends/trends/companies_score/companies_tam) all rendered cells; drilldown from folder_3a8599c11e → 2 trend cells → 1 company cell worked; breadcrumb has 3 segments and root navigation works. `explore-cell-company-NVDA` is present both in companies_score and companies_tam views. Dedup warning was triggered as designed: typing 'IA y centros de datos' + clicking 'thesis-generate-btn' rendered `dedup-warning` WITHOUT showing `thesis-loading` (no LLM call), exposed dedup-rewrite-btn / dedup-open-btn / dedup-cancel-btn / dedup-existing-link, and cancel correctly closed the panel. NO LLM credits were spent (rewrite & discover buttons were never clicked).

issues: Minor: empty-state hint inside ThesisSidebar still reads 'Aún no hay tesis ni empresas. Genera tu primera tesis.' (ThesisSidebar.jsx:171) — the user-facing copy guideline said the placeholder 'Genera tu primera tesis' should be removed from the generator area; it was correctly removed from the generator but the same wording survives in the empty-state of the sidebar. Not user-blocking with the current seed (3 items), but worth aligning if the guideline applies globally.

critical_code_review_comments: Thesis.jsx is now ~427 lines and mixes 3 concerns (generator+dedup, megatrend bar, dashboard explore container). Consider extracting MegatrendsBar into its own component (similar to ThesisSidebar/ThesisExplore) — the megatrends-bar JSX is ~25 lines and would be reusable.

ThesisExplore.jsx buildItems() is fine but does an O(N) `trends.find()` per cell in companiesOfTrend(); for large lists, memoise as a Map<trendId, trend>. Not a current bottleneck (we have 2 trends) but easy to harden.

In findDup() (Thesis.jsx:38–49), the substring fallback `tt.includes(n) || n.includes(tt)` could match overly short subjects (e.g. typing 'IA' would falsely match every IA-related thesis). Consider gating the substring match on `n.length >= 6` to avoid accidental dedupe-on-everything when the user is still typing.
ThesisSidebar CompanyTrendsDropdown closes on outside mousedown but not on Escape — minor a11y gap.

ThesisExplore relies on container width via ResizeObserver but renders cells with `position:absolute`; if the user resizes while drilled-in, the layout recomputes correctly (verified by squarify memo on [view,path,dash,w]).
